==Hero Usage==
* Heroes ignore the area of effect bonus of this skill completely. Heroes will often activate this skill on recharge, or as soon as energy is sufficient.

== Notes ==
* Cyclone Axe is a single [[attack]] that can [[hit]] multiple foes; the foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attack will fail to hit [[kiting]] opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.
